svg.title: What an Integrated Stack Gives You
svg.desc: An integrated Microsoft AI solution stacks four shared protections: one identity and permission model, enterprise data protection, Microsoft Purview compliance on AI interactions, and built-in safety and evaluations in Microsoft Foundry.
svg.text: What an Integrated Stack Gives You
New AI inherits controls you already run, instead of rebuilding them per tool.
Microsoft Entra ID; existing Microsoft 365 permissions
Prompts and responses protected; not used to train foundation models
Foundry content filters, Prompt Shields, evaluations
